title: Replace string-matched PIN error localization with typed error codes (EH-5/AX-2)

evidence.quote: 'Too many failed attempts. Try again in $remainingMinutes minute(s).',

'Incorrect PIN' => l10n.incorrectPin,
    'PINs do not match' => l10n.pinsDoNotMatch,

why: PinFlowController.errorMessage carries raw English sentinel text (EH-5: domain/data errors must carry codes/enums, never pre-formatted messages), and PinFlowScreen._resolveError maps it back to ARB strings by exact string match, with a silent `_ => raw` fallback that renders raw English verbatim on any miss. The coupling has already drifted once undetected: the switch's 'Failed to save PIN' case matches nothing PinFlowController ever produces (only the dead pin_flow_machine.dart emitted that string — see companion dead-code finding). No test in the 628-line pin_flow_controller_test.dart or the screen test exercises _resolveError, so the next wording tweak to one file without the other silently regresses Hebrew (or English) users to wrong/raw text in a security-sensitive PIN-entry flow, undetected by CI.
recommendation: Replace the free-text errorMessage field with a sealed PinFlowError enum/code on PinFlowState; have the screen switch on the enum (exhaustive switch expression, compiler-enforced) instead of string-matching English sentinels. Give PinLockoutException a stable code alongside its message. Add a widget test asserting the Locale('he') text renders for each error code.
acceptance_criteria: PinFlowState's error field is a closed enum/sealed type, not a String; pin_flow_screen.dart's switch has no fallback arm.
A test drives each PinFlowController error path and asserts the Locale('he') rendered text, not just non-null errorMessage.

corrections: The claim 'no test... exercises _resolveError' is false: test/features/profiles/pin_flow_and_setup_dialog_l1_test.dart:539-574 (B4-he) explicitly drives the Incorrect-PIN branch in Locale('he') and asserts no English leak. Remaining branches (PINs-do-not-match, No-active-profile, the ArgumentError path) are still untested for he-locale, so the core risk and P2 severity still stand, just narrower than claimed.

mergedFrom: Replace PinFlowController's raw-English error-string matching with a stable error code
